The ''Ralju Brivla Deep Structure'' hypothesis (RBDS hypothesis) is the hypothesis that the set of main [[verb]]s (mostly [[gismu]]) constitute a complete vector space for the expression of all meaning. In other words: that the Lojban main verbs set is sufficient to express all possible predicates, without separate [[lujvo]], without tanru, and (here's the controversial bit) without [[preposition]]s. It presumes that all of these can be expressed with sentences (inordinately complex and ugly sentences, true) involving just the set of main verbs and cmavo (other than prepositions.)
